lookback_hours.description: The window the CALLER already applied when selecting closed_issues and opened_issues. Used for the headline label only — this skill does no time filtering of its own.

project_title.description: Display name of the board, for the digest headline. Defaults to "Development Project".

repositories.description: The owner/repo scope the caller applied. When the board spans repos beyond this list, the digest says so.

project_items.description: Current board contents — the SCOPE SET. Every reported ticket must appear here.

status.description: Current board status column, verbatim. Current value only — never a history.

closed_issues.description: Issues whose closed_at falls inside the window, already filtered by the caller.

linked_pr.description: The PR that closed the issue, when the caller resolved one.

comments.description: Trailing issue comments — the gist fallback when there is no linked PR.

opened_issues.description: Issues whose created_at falls inside the window, already filtered by the caller.

in_progress_statuses.description: Board status values to treat as in-progress. Absent, treat any status that is neither a done nor a backlog column as in-progress.

trigger_type.description: How the run started — manual, cron, or agent_call. Selects draft vs finished tone.
